PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which the movement is due to take place (cash and/or securities).

AvailableDate.name: Available Date
AvailableDate.definition: Date/time at which securities become available for trading, for example first dealing date.

DividendRankingDate.name: Dividend Ranking Date
DividendRankingDate.definition: Date/time at which a security will be entitled to a dividend.

EarliestPaymentDate.name: Earliest Payment Date
EarliestPaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which a payment can be made, for example, if payment date is a non-business day or to indicate the first payment date of an offer.

PariPassuDate.name: Pari Passu Date
PariPassuDate.definition: Date/time at which security will assimilate, become fungible, or have the same rights to dividends as the parent issue.

LastTradingDate.name: Last Trading Date
LastTradingDate.definition: Date/time at which the securities to be reorganised will cease to be tradeable.
